cameras.fault: PoE Voltage Drop / High resistance fault
cameras.action: Inspect patch panel terminations, measure resistance with cable certifier.

cameras.fault: Water ingress in outdoor RJ45 connector
cameras.action: Replace RJ45 with IP67 weatherproof grommet and seal junction box.

cameras.fault: Crimp failure at pole terminal box
cameras.action: Re-terminate RJ45 connector using gold-plated pass-through plug.

cameras.fault: Junction box loose wiring / bent pin in PoE port
cameras.action: Check PoE port on switch and inspect RJ45 jack pins.

cameras.fault: Cat6 Signal Loss / Broken conductor in conduit
cameras.action: Tone & trace cable run; re-punch keystone or pull new Cat6 UTP cable.

cameras.fault: PoE Voltage Drop / High resistance fault
cameras.action: Inspect patch panel terminations, measure resistance with cable certifier.

cameras.fault: IR Cut filter stuck / daytime black & white
cameras.action: Cycle IR cut mechanically; if persistent, swap camera assembly.

cameras.fault: Water intrusion / lens fogging inside dome
cameras.action: Disassemble, dry with silica packet, replace O-ring seal or replace camera.

cameras.fault: Firmware bootloop / unresponsive to ping and ARP
cameras.action: Attempt TFTP firmware flash; replace mainboard if bricked.

cameras.fault: No Power / Internal PoE PCB failure
